purpose: Inspect the fund-disclosed issuer name paired with each of the four stable security identifiers; especially NVDA CUSIP 67066G104 where own 10-K cover has ticker but no CUSIP.
decision_rule: Fund-disclosed issuer name, CUSIP and ISIN are a security description, not an issuer CIK. Require a dated own-company filing or equivalent linkage before monthly historical identity qualification.
